description: Generates every SwiftUI Color initializer for a color: Color(red:green:blue:), opacity variant, Color(.sRGB), Color(.displayP3), HSB, hex-extension call, #colorLiteral, UIColor/NSColor bridges — plus a reusable `extension Color` snippet and Asset Catalog Contents.json.

alpha.description: Opacity 0–1. Defaults to the input's alpha, or 1.

color.description: Color in any supported notation: hex (#F43, #FF6347, #FF6347CC), rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), a CSS named color (tomato), or a Tailwind token (red-500).

name.description: Optional swatch name for the `extension Color` snippet (e.g. "Brand Primary" → `Color.brandPrimary`).

name: swiftui_color
title: SwiftUI Color Code
